Job Summary
Oversees the activities of clinical performance and outcomes reporting. Works with internal and facility teams to develop data management processes and reporting for comparative purposes across the enterprise. Creates data packages for facility and corporate leadership for decision making through strong understanding of performance improvement techniques necessary to influence change and modify systems.
Essential Functions

• Plans, oversees, and evaluates performance improvement reporting activities for assigned facilities.

• Supports facility leadership with information necessary for overall day-to-day quality activities, decision support and Board oversight preparation.

• Identifies leading practices for achievement in quality improvement and shares with key stakeholders to hardwire best practices

• Compiles, analyzes and distributes pertinent clinical data as it relates to outcomes and resource utilization; provides support and monitors assigned facilities; responds to user based questions and training requests, and follows-up based on variation.

• Ensures on-going system trending is maintained and assessed to identify priorities and opportunities for improvement; continuously generates ideas for improvement.

• Assists in the development of quality goals and provides supporting data to achieve these goals.

• Works collaboratively with various departments to achieve facility and enterprise quality and safety goals.

• Assists with the development and revision of policies and procedures to enable continuous quality improvement.

• Provides analytical leadership and consultative services; serves as the primary liaison with tool vendor.

• Assists with ambulatory, post-acute and regional quality activities, as applicable.

• Promotes the philosophy, mission and administrative policies to ensure quality care and patient safety.

• Provides direct education to users in clinical applications, as well as support to trainers in the field.

Physical Requirements
Can clearly communicate verbally, in person, and in writing with patients, families, agencies and the healthcare team. Must possess a strong sense of urgency and make sound decisions. Excellent interpersonal communication skills. Within limited time elements, carries out responsibilities in a professional manner always, as well as possesses ability to work cooperatively and effectively with other teammates on an individual and team basis. Works in an office environment which requires long periods of sitting and computer use. Travels to facilities in personal vehicle as needed.
Education, Experience and Certifications
Bachelor’s Degree required; Master’s Degree preferred. RN or other clinical licensure preferred. Certification in health care quality, patient safety or related regulatory entity preferred. 3 years’ quality improvement experience required (Preferably in tertiary care setting). Additional experience in post-acute and ambulatory quality preferred. Certification and knowledge of Lean concepts preferred. Advanced computer skills, and direct knowledge of data analysis techniques including statistical displays at a macro and micro level required. Advanced business communication skills preferred.

**Job Summary**

The mission of Arch Mortgage Data, Reporting and Insights team is to unlock the power of data through insightful reporting and analytics, empowering stakeholders to confidently make data-driven decisions. The team strives to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights which drive business growth and success while continuously innovating and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in reporting and data analytics.  


The Senior Data Analyst is a hands-on analytical and technical contributor who supports this mission by building reliable data pipelines, analytics-ready data assets, reports, dashboards, and data-driven insights on modern platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, and Azure. This role partners with business stakeholders to understand needs, translate requirements into practical data solutions, and deliver work that is accurate, reusable, and well documented.

**Responsibilities**

*Data & Analytics Solutions*

* Design, develop, and support data solutions, including data pipelines, analytical datasets, reports, dashboards, and automation that enable business decision-making.
    
* Acquire, integrate, transform, and validate data from a variety of internal and external sources, ensuring data is accurate, consistent, secure, and accessible.
    
* Perform data analysis, modeling, reconciliation, and trend evaluation to identify actionable insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations.
    

*Business Partnership & Delivery*

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, gather requirements, and translate business needs into scalable data and analytics solutions.
    
* Manage multiple priorities while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
    

*Technology, Innovation & Quality*

* Leverage modern cloud-based data and analytics platforms, automation technologies, and AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, accelerate solution delivery, and enhance solution quality.
    
* Apply established development practices, including testing, documentation, version control, peer review, and change management, to ensure reliable, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
    
* Troubleshoot data, process, and performance issues, identify root causes, and implement effective resolutions while continuously improving existing solutions.
    

*Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing*

* Serve as a subject matter resource within assigned business domains and support team success through knowledge sharing, documentation, collaboration, and informal mentoring.
    

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities within complex datasets.
    
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, and modern data analytics, automation, and reporting techniques.
    
* Knowledge of data warehousing, data modeling, data integration, and analytics solution design principles.
    
* Strong understanding of cloud-based data and analytics ecosystems, including the ability to develop and support scalable solutions using modern platforms and technologies.
    
* Experience utilizing business intelligence, data visualization, and analytical tools to communicate insights and support decision-making.
    
* Familiarity with AI-assisted productivity and analytics tools, and the ability to effectively leverage these technologies to improve quality, efficiency, and outcomes.
    
* Ability to translate business requirements into effective data and analytics solutions and communicate complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
    
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and collaboration skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing priorities.
    

## Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, or a related discipline; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
    
* 3+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, data engineering, or related disciplines, including experience independently delivering data and analytics solutions and partnering with business stakeholders.

+ Demonstrate strong collaboration skills by partnering with business teams to gather reporting requirements and translate them into scalable analytical solutions.
+ Explore and analyze data to identify trends and outliers, evaluate compliance with internal policy/procedures and/or regulatory requirements, and assess root cause(s) of any issues identified.
+ Develop data models and data visualization standards that support regulatory reporting, compliance monitoring, control testing, risk assessments, and issue management activities. Ensure data accuracy through validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance procedures. Optimize Tableau workbooks for performance, usability, scalability, and maintenance.
+ Connect Tableau to multiple data sources, including SQL Server, cloud-based data warehouses, data lakes, and enterprise reporting repositories.
+ Develop and support automated reporting processes and recurring management reporting packages. Create technical documentation, data dictionaries, and user training materials.
+ Support audits, regulatory examinations, and management inquiries related to compliance reporting and analytics.
+ Working knowledge, as well as ability and interest in maintaining, and continuously developing knowledge of banking products (e.g. – lending, deposits, etc.) and ability to understand its applicability to data analytics, testing, and monitoring strategies.
+ Ability and interest in developing knowledge of financial services industry source systems (e.g. loan origination/servicing, deposits, etc.), operations/process flows, banking regulations, and compliance frameworks.
Required Qualifications
+ Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology/Systems (IT / MIS), Business Analytics, Computer Science, or other related quantitative or IT field of study.
+ Minimum 2 years of practical and functional experience in data analysis and reporting typically achieved through work as a: business, data, operations, compliance, or risk analyst; internal auditor; or role that includes significant aspects of the listed essential job functions.
+ Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations, window functions, and performance optimization.
+ Skill and ability to work with big data and navigate data warehouse(s) and retrieving, combining, and analyzing data.
+ Experience with retrieving and a proficient understanding of banking products and transactional data and customer information data.
+ Autonomous, self-motivated, and flexible with the ability to adapt quickly to change or shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
+ High ethical standards, strong critical/strategic thinking, detective, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
+ Strong interpersonal skills, effective communication (verbal and written) with the ability to develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships in a team environment and with mid- to senior-level management and internal clients.
+ Required Technical Skills: Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server / Tableau Cloud, SQL, Data Visualization and Dashboard Design, Microsoft Excel
Preferred Skills/Competencies
+ Knowledge of financial services industry source systems (e.g. loan origination/servicing, deposits, etc.), operations/process flows, banking regulations, and compliance frameworks.
+ Advanced knowledge, professional certification, or expertise in database querying, data transformation, data visualization, and/or analytical software or programming languages (e.g. SAS, SQL, ACL, Tableau, etc.)
+ Preferred Technical Skills: Python, SAS, BigQuery, Power BI, ETL and Data Integration Tools
